title: Camping World Reports Q3 2026 Revenue of $1.58 Billion
summary: Camping World reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.58 billion and a net loss of $320.1 million, including a $286.7 million goodwill impairment.
body_markdown:
The net loss was $290.7 million larger than a year earlier. Diluted loss per Class A share was $3.09, up $2.45 from the third quarter of 2025, and adjusted diluted loss per share was $0.19, against adjusted diluted earnings per share of $0.43. Adjusted EBITDA fell 62.4% to $36.0 million, including a $12.7 million unfavorable impact from finance and insurance chargeback liability adjustments, the company said.


The noncash goodwill impairment relates to the RV and Outdoor Retail reporting unit. The company said it was largely driven by continued pressure on new RV industry demand, promotional pricing pressure in core travel trailer offerings, the sustained decline in its share price and macroeconomic factors. SG&A expenses fell 5.8% to $387.1 million. Chief Executive Officer Matthew Wagner said the company implemented "additional reductions amounting to over $50 million of anticipated incremental annualized savings."


## Why It Matters for CWH


The release repeats the outlook the company disclosed on October 5, 2026: full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA below the low end of its previously communicated range of $230 million to $270 million, with no additional full-year 2026 guidance. Camping World expects fourth-quarter 2026 SG&A to decline by more than $50 million year over year and intends to discuss its framework for 2027 with its fourth-quarter results.
